<function name="OnContextMenuClose" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when the context menu keybind (+menu_context) is released, which by default is C.

This hook will not run if <page>input.IsKeyTrapping</page> returns true.

See also <page>GM:OnContextMenuOpen</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
